name: Pokemon Stadium 2 Overworld Models - Gold/Silver (Gen 2)
description: Standalone Gold/Silver Gen-2 voxel + Stadium 2 mod. v0.2.15 re-enables Lugia's real Stadium 2 3D model with a Dex-249 hierarchy-repair probe that tests normal, absolute-translation, and flat bind interpretations, recomputes repaired stance sizing, and forces Lugia body textures opaque; the 2D Lugia card is now last-resort only. Overworld capture is harder with a smaller strength-scaled hit zone, faster precision ring for strong Pokemon, stricter NICE/GREAT/EXCELLENT thresholds, and throws that visibly travel to the actual aimed miss point. Retains v0.2.14 first-map 3RD/1ST trainer animation, v0.2.12 L2/right-mouse aim and R2/left-click throw, connected-map streaming, cameras, battle FX, and crash-safe live battles.
